name: fizzle_without_reveal
description: A corked bottle with no valid reveal by fizzle_t (25 s after the horn) fizzles (contract-m7 §2): seat 2 corks the Gourd Rush in window 2 and never uncorks; at 1499 ticks after the horn it is still corked, on the 1500th EV_FIZZLE, the 30 gold stays spent, no stipend and no creep follow, and an UNCORK after it finds nothing corked. Seat 1's wave waits for the bottle (SimUndertow.holds): its eight arrows by the Welling have killed all of wave 2 long before, yet its wave clears only on the fizzle's tick, and SimMatch.wave_held says so to the views meanwhile (seat 2's, with no bottle aimed at it, is not).

steps.eval: [scene.cmd(1, 'BUILD', 0, 3, 3), scene.cmd(1, 'BUILD', 0, 4, 3), scene.cmd(1, 'BUILD', 0, 5, 3), scene.cmd(1, 'BUILD', 0, 6, 3), scene.cmd(1, 'BUILD', 0, 4, 1), scene.cmd(1, 'BUILD', 0, 5, 1), scene.cmd(1, 'BUILD', 0, 6, 1), scene.cmd(1, 'BUILD', 0, 8, 3)]

steps.msg: through tick 1499 after the horn the bottle is corked

steps.assert: m.creeps_on(0) == 0 and m.spawns_left(0) == 0 and m.hollows[0].phase == 1 and m.wave_held(0) and not m.wave_held(1)
steps.msg: seat 1's road is empty, yet its wave waits for the bottle

steps.assert: scene.rows('FIZZLE', ['tick', 'seat']) == [[horn + 1500, 2]] and m.bottles(2)[0]['fizzled'] and not m.bottles(2)[0].has('pack')
steps.msg: on tick 1500 after the horn it fizzled, its pack never named

steps.assert: scene.events_where('WAVE', {'hollow': 0, 'cleared': true, 'wave': 2})[0]['tick'] == horn + 1500 and not m.wave_held(0)
steps.msg: and seat 1's wave cleared on that tick

steps.assert: scene.last_refusal(2) == 'NOTHING_CORKED' and m.stipend(2) == 0 and scene.sent_by(2) == [] and scene.rows('GOLD', ['change'], {'seat': 2, 'why': 'cork'}) == [[-30]] and scene.gold_to(2, 'stipend') == 0
steps.msg: too late to reveal: the gold stays spent, no stipend, no creeps
